cases.question: RFC 2119 中 MUST、REQUIRED 和 SHALL 表达什么要求？
cases.reference_answer: They indicate an absolute requirement of the specification.

gold.quote: 1. MUST   This word, or the terms "REQUIRED" or "SHALL", mean that the
definition is an absolute requirement of the specification.

cases.question: RFC 2119 中 MUST NOT 与 SHALL NOT 表示什么？
cases.reference_answer: They indicate an absolute prohibition.

gold.quote: 2. MUST NOT   This phrase, or the phrase "SHALL NOT", mean that the
definition is an absolute prohibition of the specification.

cases.question: RFC 2119 中 MAY / OPTIONAL 是否允许供应商选择不实现某项功能？
cases.reference_answer: Yes. The item is truly optional; vendors may include it or omit it.

gold.quote: 5. MAY   This word, or the adjective "OPTIONAL", mean that an item is
truly optional.  One vendor may choose to include the item because a
particular marketplace requires it or because the vendor feels that
it enhances the product while another vendor may omit the same item.

cases.question: RFC 3339 的 timestamp 表示一个时刻，还是一段时间间隔？
cases.reference_answer: An unambiguous instant in time, not periods or intervals.

gold.quote: o  Date and time expressions indicate an instant in time.
Description of time periods, or intervals, is not covered here.
Timestamp   This term is used in this document to refer to an
unambiguous representation of some instant in time.

cases.question: RFC 3339 中 Z 后缀表示什么时区偏移？
cases.reference_answer: A UTC offset of 00:00, also called Zulu.

gold.quote: Z           A suffix which, when applied to a time, denotes a UTC
offset of 00:00; often spoken "Zulu" from the ICAO
phonetic alphabet representation of the letter "Z".

cases.question: NIST SP 800-145 的云模型包含多少种基本特征、服务模型和部署模型？
cases.reference_answer: Five essential characteristics, three service models and four deployment models.

gold.quote: This cloud model is composed of five essential characteristics, three service models, and four deployment
models.

cases.question: NIST 的按需自助服务是否需要与服务提供商人员逐次交互？
cases.reference_answer: No. Consumers provision capabilities unilaterally and automatically without human interaction with each provider.

gold.quote: On-demand self-service. A consumer can unilaterally provision computing capabilities, such as
server time and network storage, as needed automatically without requiring human
interaction with each service provider.

cases.question: NIST 定义的 public cloud 面向谁开放，设施位于哪里？
cases.reference_answer: Open use by the general public; on the premises of the cloud provider.

gold.quote: Public cloud. The cloud infrastructure is provisioned for open use by the general public. It may be
owned, managed, and operated by a business, academic, or government organization, or
some combination of them.  It exists on the premises of the cloud provider.

cases.question: RFC 3339 要求 Internet 协议生成年份时使用几位数字？
cases.reference_answer: Four-digit years are mandatory.

gold.quote: o  Internet Protocols MUST generate four digit years in dates.

cases.question: NIST SP 800-145 的目标读者有哪些角色？
cases.reference_answer: System planners, program managers, technologists and others adopting cloud computing as consumers or providers.

gold.quote: The intended audience of this document is system planners, program managers, technologists, and others
adopting cloud computing as consumers or providers of cloud services.

cases.question: RFC 3339 的 UTC 已知而本地偏移未知时，使用哪一种 offset 表示？
cases.reference_answer: Use -00:00; it differs semantically from Z or +00:00.

gold.quote: If the time in UTC is known, but the offset to local time is unknown,
this can be represented with an offset of "-00:00".  This differs
semantically from an offset of "Z" or "+00:00", which imply that UTC
is the preferred reference point for the specified time.  RFC2822
[IMAIL-UPDATE] describes a similar convention for email.

cases.question: 按 NIST 定义，private cloud 是否只能部署在组织自有场地？
cases.reference_answer: No. It may exist on or off premises.

gold.quote: Private cloud. The cloud infrastructure is provisioned for exclusive use by a single organization
comprising multiple consumers (e.g., business units). It may be owned, managed, and
operated by the organization, a third party, or some combination of them, and it may exist
on or off premises.

cases.question: RFC 2119 如何区分 SHOULD 与 MUST？忽略 SHOULD 前需要考虑什么？
cases.reference_answer: MUST is absolute. SHOULD permits justified exceptions in particular circumstances, after understanding and weighing the full implications.

gold.quote: 1. MUST   This word, or the terms "REQUIRED" or "SHALL", mean that the
definition is an absolute requirement of the specification.
3. SHOULD   This word, or the adjective "RECOMMENDED", mean that there
may exist valid reasons in particular circumstances to ignore a
particular item, but the full implications must be understood and
carefully weighed before choosing a different course.

cases.question: RFC 2119 对实现可选功能与不实现可选功能的两方各有什么互操作要求？
cases.reference_answer: Each MUST interoperate with the other, allowing reduced functionality; the implementation with the option may require it for the feature that option provides.

gold.quote: An implementation which does not include a particular option MUST be
prepared to interoperate with another implementation which does
include the option, though perhaps with reduced functionality. In the
same vein an implementation which does include a particular option
MUST be prepared to interoperate with another implementation which
does not include the option (except, of course, for the feature the
option provides.)

cases.question: RFC 3339 如何定义 leap year？为什么有些世纪年不是闰年？
cases.reference_answer: A leap year has 366 days; divisibility by four is required, with century years also divisible by 400.

gold.quote: leap year   In the Gregorian calendar, a year which has 366 days.
A leap year is a year whose number is divisible by
four an integral number of times, except that if it is
a centennial year (i.e. divisible by one hundred) it
shall also be divisible by four hundred an integral
number of times.

cases.question: RFC 3339 对插入闰秒、删除闰秒和普通时刻的秒字段最大值分别规定多少？
cases.reference_answer: 60 for an inserted leap second, 58 when a leap second is subtracted, otherwise 59.

gold.quote: The grammar element time-second may have the value "60" at the end of
months in which a leap second occurs -- to date: June (XXXX-06-
30T23:59:60Z) or December (XXXX-12-31T23:59:60Z); see Appendix D for
a table of leap seconds.  It is also possible for a leap second to be
subtracted, at which times the maximum value of time-second is "58".
At all other times the maximum value of time-second is "59".

cases.question: NIST 所说的资源池化与快速弹性分别解决什么问题？
cases.reference_answer: Resource pooling dynamically assigns shared resources to multiple consumers; rapid elasticity scales capabilities outward and inward with demand.

gold.quote: Resource pooling. The provider’s computing resources are pooled to serve multiple consumers
using a multi-tenant model, with different physical and virtual resources dynamically
assigned and reassigned according to consumer demand. There is a sense of location
Rapid elasticity. Capabilities can be elastically provisioned and released, in some cases
automatically, to scale rapidly outward and inward commensurate with demand. To the
consumer, the capabilities available for provisioning often appear to be unlimited and can
be appropriated in any quantity at any time.

cases.question: NIST 的 hybrid cloud 要求组成部分保持什么性质，以及支持何种可移植性？
cases.reference_answer: Two or more distinct cloud infrastructures remain unique entities and are bound by technology enabling data and application portability.

gold.quote: Hybrid cloud. The cloud infrastructure is a composition of two or more distinct cloud
infrastructures (private, community, or public) that remain unique entities, but are bound
together by standardized or proprietary technology that enables data and application
portability (e.g., cloud bursting for load balancing between clouds).

cases.question: RFC 3339 允许 timestamp 的小时写成 24 吗？不要把 ISO 8601 的宽松规则混入。
cases.reference_answer: No. This RFC profile only permits 00 through 23 even though ISO 8601 permits 24.

gold.quote: Although ISO 8601 permits the hour to be "24", this profile of ISO
8601 only allows values between "00" and "23" for the hour in order
to reduce confusion.

cases.question: RFC 3339 的 T 和 Z 必须在所有使用场景中都是大写吗？
cases.reference_answer: The syntax allows lowercase t/z; particular specifications may further require uppercase, and generators SHOULD use uppercase.

gold.quote: NOTE: Per [ABNF] and ISO8601, the "T" and "Z" characters in this
syntax may alternatively be lower case "t" or "z" respectively.
and 'a'-'z' (e.g. XML).  Specifications that use this format in
such environments MAY further limit the date/time syntax so that
the letters 'T' and 'Z' used in the date/time syntax must always
be upper case.  Applications that generate this format SHOULD use
upper case letters.

cases.question: NIST 资源池化中的位置独立，是否禁止消费者指定国家或数据中心？
cases.reference_answer: No. Exact resource location is generally unknown, but location may be specified at a higher abstraction such as country, state or datacenter.

gold.quote: independence in that the customer generally has no control or knowledge over the exact
location of the provided resources but may be able to specify location at a higher level of
abstraction (e.g., country, state, or datacenter). Examples of resources include storage,
processing, memory, and network bandwidth.

cases.question: RFC 2119 的 SHOULD NOT 是否意味着任何情况下都禁止此行为？
cases.reference_answer: No. There may be valid particular circumstances where it is acceptable or useful; full implications must be understood and the case weighed.

gold.quote: 4. SHOULD NOT   This phrase, or the phrase "NOT RECOMMENDED" mean that
there may exist valid reasons in particular circumstances when the
particular behavior is acceptable or even useful, but the full
implications should be understood and the case carefully weighed
before implementing any behavior described with this label.

cases.question: RFC 3339 的字符串排序能否无条件代替时间排序？
cases.reference_answer: No. Conditions include the same timezone representation, same number of fractional digits and no optional punctuation.

gold.quote: If date and time components are ordered from least precise to most
precise, then a useful property is achieved.  Assuming that the time
zones of the dates and times are the same (e.g., all in UTC),
expressed using the same string (e.g., all "Z" or all "+00:00"), and
all times have the same number of fractional second digits, then the
date and time strings may be sorted as strings (e.g., using the
strcmp() function in C) and a time-ordered sequence will result.  The
presence of optional punctuation would violate this characteristic.

cases.question: 按 RFC 3339，2001 年的 2 月 29 日能作为合法 date-mday 吗？
cases.reference_answer: No. February in a normal year has 28 days, and 2001 is not divisible by four.

gold.quote: 02            February, normal     28
02            February, leap year  29
leap year   In the Gregorian calendar, a year which has 366 days.
A leap year is a year whose number is divisible by
four an integral number of times, except that if it is
a centennial year (i.e. divisible by one hundred) it
shall also be divisible by four hundred an integral
number of times.

cases.question: NIST SP 800-145 要求所有云都由商业公司拥有吗？
cases.reference_answer: No. For example, public cloud may be owned or managed by business, academic or government organizations or combinations.

gold.quote: Public cloud. The cloud infrastructure is provisioned for open use by the general public. It may be

cases.question: RFC 3339 是否要求现在就生成多年以后的闰秒 timestamp？
cases.reference_answer: No. Leap seconds cannot be predicted far ahead; applications should wait until they are announced.

gold.quote: Leap seconds cannot be predicted far into the future.  The
International Earth Rotation Service publishes bulletins [IERS] that
announce leap seconds with a few weeks' warning.  Applications should
not generate timestamps involving inserted leap seconds until after
the leap seconds are announced.

cases.reference_answer: time-secfrac is a dot followed by one or more digits; at least one digit.

gold.quote: time-secfrac    = "." 1*DIGIT

cases.question: 请定位 RFC 3339 月份表：April 的 date-mday 最大值是多少？
cases.reference_answer: April (month 04) has a maximum date-mday of 30.

gold.quote: 04            April                30

cases.question: 请定位 NIST SP 800-145 对 measured service 的说明：计量信息为哪两方提供透明度？
cases.reference_answer: Both the provider and consumer of the utilized service.

gold.quote: monitored, controlled, and reported, providing transparency for both the provider and
consumer of the utilized service.

cases.question: 请定位 NIST 的 PaaS 定义：消费者控制什么，不管理哪些基础设施？
cases.reference_answer: Consumers control deployed applications and possibly hosting environment configuration, but not underlying networks, servers, operating systems or storage.

gold.quote: not manage or control the underlying cloud infrastructure including network, servers,
operating systems, or storage, but has control over the deployed applications and possibly
configuration settings for the application-hosting environment.

cases.question: 请定位 RFC 2119：作者应解释不遵循规范的什么方面的影响？
cases.reference_answer: Security implications of not following recommendations or requirements.

gold.quote: These terms are frequently used to specify behavior with security
implications.  The effects on security of not implementing a MUST or
SHOULD, or doing something the specification says MUST NOT or SHOULD
NOT be done may be very subtle. Document authors should take the time
to elaborate the security implications of not following
recommendations or requirements as most implementors will not have
had the benefit of the experience and discussion that produced the
specification.

cases.question: 请定位 RFC 3339 示例：1996-12-19T16:39:57-08:00 对应哪个 UTC timestamp？

gold.quote: This represents 39 minutes and 57 seconds after the 16th hour of
December 19th, 1996 with an offset of -08:00 from UTC (Pacific
Standard Time).  Note that this is equivalent to 1996-12-20T00:39:57Z
in UTC.
